policy: Blocked, unavailable, restricted, culturally controlled or unverified material remains an explicit gap and never becomes complete by deadline pressure.

parallel_workstreams.goal: Acquire, page-account, OCR/transcribe, structure and audit Encyclopaedia Mundarica I-XVI without conflating human review, OCR and machine VERIFIED COMPLETE.
Systematic source census, deterministic canonicalization and permitted evidence ingestion across all source classes.
Populate SOURCE→PASSAGE/SEGMENT/EVENT/OBJECT→EVIDENCE→CLAIM→INDICATOR→DOMAIN with exact locators, scope, uncertainty and access controls.
Keep all registered information-architecture modules mapped and progressively evidence-populated with universal search, evidence drilldown, reports/downloads and authenticated research tooling.
Preserve provenance, consent, cultural access, safety, rights/licence and commercial-reuse decisions; cultural access always overrides entitlement.
Keep the Q1-target manuscript reproducible and repository-metric synchronized; no manually inflated counts or unsupported completion claims.
